CoupleCAM 2.0 on-device composition advisor

SmolVLM-256M-Instruct, Hugging Face Smol Models Research, Apache License 2.0.
https://huggingface.co/HuggingFaceTB/SmolVLM-256M-Instruct
Input checkpoints in the publisher's onnx directory: vision_encoder_q4.onnx,
decoder_model_merged_q4.onnx and embed_tokens_int8.onnx.
CoupleCAM specializes the vision graph for one letterboxed image and the
language decoder for one fixed image question. It folds the prompt embeddings
and empty initial cache into the graph. The language head evaluates candidate
first-word tokens and pools them into scene categories, including an
out-of-scope category. No retraining. See model-LICENSE.txt.

Microsoft ONNX Runtime Android 1.23.2. See ort-license.txt and ort-notices.txt.
https://central.sonatype.com/artifact/com.microsoft.onnxruntime/onnxruntime-android/1.23.2
